mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sn_factory ORDER BY factory_code ASC
SELECT * FROM sn_factory WHERE factory_code = #{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT factory_code FROM sn_factory WHERE enabled = 0
SELECT factory_code FROM sn_factory WHERE mes_enabled = 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sn_factory WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND mes_enabled = 1)
SELECT tz_offset_min FROM sn_factory WHERE factory_code = #{code}

SELECT factory_code k, COUNT(*) n FROM ( SELECT factory_code, id FROM sn_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND factory_code IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.factory_code, u.id FROM sn_user_factory b JOIN sn_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' ) t GROUP BY factory_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sn_factory(factory_code, factory_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, 1, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE sn_factory SET factory_name = #{name}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE factory_code = #{code}
UPDATE sn_factory SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE factory_code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_push_task WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING')
SELECT batch_no, qty, result FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND result IN ('UNCONFIRMED','FAILED') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND result IN ('UNCONFIRMED','FAILED')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND result IN ('UNCONFIRMED','FAILED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND status = 'TO_PUSH' AND push_type = 'REASSIGN' AND mes_holder = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE status = 'ALLOCATED' AND factory_code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE status = 'TO_PUSH' AND factory_code = #{code} AND delivery_batch_no IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE sn_item SET status = 'TO_PUSH', push_type = 'NEW', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'ALLOCATED' AND factory_code = #{code}
UPDATE sn_item SET status = 'ALLOCATED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'TO_PUSH' AND factory_code = #{code} AND delivery_batch_no IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sn_push_task WHERE factory_code = #{code} AND state IN ('STOPPED','DONE')
mapper.update: UPDATE sn_factory SET mes_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE factory_code = #{code}
